notes.title: Playtest Patch Update v1.6
notes.content:
[h1]HamSumo Playtest Patch v1.6 notes:[/h1]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where being put in recoil while ducking would cause the player to be stuck in the duck state

[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]
[h3]Hamstein:[/h3]
Level 2 Star Move:
- Now only consumes one buff and throws one projectile
- The projectile direction can now be controlled by the player

Level 1 Star Move:
- Updated VFX
- Teleporting through another player now applies hitstun and slight vertical knockback allowing for a follow-up attack

- Now knocks back opponents when hit (Knockback strength is based on Hamozuna's speed)

Level 3 Star Move:
- Decreased vertical hitbox to make jumping over the move possible
- Decreased horizontal hitbox to match vfx
- Decreased fall speed to prevent clipping through the stage
- Adjusted overall move duration to account for the decreased fall speed

[h2]Stage Changes:[/h2]
[h3]Ship Stage:[/h3]
- Increased stage size
- Moved spawn points up to avoid characters clipping into the floor when respawning

notes.title: Playtest Patch Update v1.4
notes.content:
[h2]HamSumo Playtest Patch v1.4 notes:[/h2]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

 - Fixed an issue where ducking after fastfalling would cause the ducking and moving states to overlap
 - Fixed an issue where shadows would grow extremely large under some circumstances
 - Fixed an issue where boost charge would persist after a KO if the button was held
 - Fixed an issue where Hamozuna's level 3 would persist after a KO
 - Made level 3 star moves fully invincible, preventing scenarios where it would be possible to be put into the recoil state while the move was active, causing unintended effects
 - Fixed an issue where Hamstein would no longer be able to jump after drinking 3 Size Serums
 - Fixed an issue where Hamoichi would KO herself if she used her level 3 on the edge of the stump stage
 
[h3]New Stage[/h3]
 - Spaceship stage was added!
 The glass walls of the ship can be broken if they take enough damage, causing the stage to become more and more precarious over the course of each battle!
